x: Birchfield had a good four running for them and although Vic Blowfield gave us the lead on the first leg, which Ted Stimpson maintained on the second stage, Bill Lucas had to give way to Reeves of Birchfield and Bobby Reid went off with a good lead from George Lucas for the last lap.

Tom Clinton ran a good leg and handed over to George Lucas at Merstham in sixth place. George started with supreme confidence on his 4½ miles jaunt up Redhill and along the switchback to the Prince Albert where he handed over in second place, clocking 22 mins. 36 secs., only 4 secs. slower running t…

Vic Blowfield and Len Herbert were notable absentees but Ted Stimpson ran a good race to beat George Lucas with both Archie Bedford and Eddie Short causing rather a surprise by their forward positions.
George Lucas and Len Herbert had what was to them rather a disappointing season and we hope that a full season over the country will see them both fighting fit for next track season.
At the half-distance Ted Stimpson was in the lead followed by Len Herbert and George Lucas, but when the runners came in sight of the finish Len Herbert was in front and running strongly.
We were pleased to see Derrick Burfitt out again, and he led the field from start to finish, with Archie Bedford as runner-up and George Lucas third.

Ted Stimpson and George Lucas found that they could not match the pace of the younger members of the Club but will no doubt come again, especially if they train really hard as one has to do if they hope to stand any chance of making our teams these days.
In the 3 miles Team Race we had Jack Bragginton, George Lucas, Steve Charlton and Len Bishop, but could only manage a 4th place in this event.

Rather naturally there were new names in our team in Vic Blowfield, George Lucas, Stan Eales, Eric Herbert and Albert Frost. It is interesting to note that of our ten runners, six were past or future Internationals.

Len Marchant had to be content with fifth place in a fast-run 880 yards and George Lucas ran well to gain third place behind Lataster (Holland) and Olney (TVH) in the 3 miles, Len Herbert coming through late to finish sixth."
